name: audit2f event listener with an optional parameter
source: import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"; function main(): void { const e = new EventEmitter(); e.on("a", (x: number, y?: string) => console.log("a", x, y)); e.emit("a", 1); e.emit("a", 1, "s", "extra"); e.once("b", (x: number) => console.log("b", x)); e.emit("b", 7); e.emit("b", 8); console.log(e.listenerCount("b"), e.eventNames()); }
